fusions.name: Snapped Tongue
fusions.desc: A tongue-like arm snaps out, dealing 34 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Spat Spray
fusions.desc: Spits a cone of water 6 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring Off the Rock
fusions.desc: A sudden spring that carries you 5 tiles forward.

fusions.name: Damp Hide
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, your damp skin closes the wound: you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
